hints.title: Filter High Value Bills
hints.text: Filter store records to isolate bills whose value strictly exceeds five hundred.

hints.title: Customer Deduplication
hints.text: Ensure each qualifying customer is counted only once regardless of how many qualifying bills they hold.

hints.title: Aggregate Count Expression
hints.text: Use distinct count aggregation over customer identifiers to compute the final total.

hints.title: Complete Query
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS rich_count
FROM Store
WHERE amount > 500;
```

complexity.space: O(U) distinct customer id hash set
complexity.notes: Filters bills with amount > 500 and counts distinct customer identifiers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting raw bills without DISTINCT overcounts customers who have multiple rich bills.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash aggregation on customer_id deduplicates qualifying customers in a single pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should combine WHERE filter with COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id).

solutions.approach: Filter for amount > 500 and count distinct customer identifiers.
PostgreSQL count distinct customer query with amount predicate.
Filter amount > 500 and calculate nunique of customer_id.
